response.sql: WITH qc_counts AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), totals AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM qc_counts) SELECT c.fundflux, c.cnt, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.total_cnt AS share_of_total, c.cnt * 1.0 / t.avg_cnt AS ratio_to_avg FROM qc_counts c CROSS JOIN totals t
